Instrumentation and Control
Maintenance procedures
Document No.: MI-004-r0a

Equipment:
Control circuit of the electric feed pump for unit No. 2
ABB

Issued to:
Assiut
3 x 30 MW

Status:
Approved

Approval date:
28 March 2007

Procedure:
Checking the pump trip indication signal

Next review date: March
2012

This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the electric feed pump trip indication signal for unit No. 2 not appearing on the boiler panel and the pump switch indication lamp on the control desk; these procedures are carried out when a fault occurs in the electric feed pump trip indication signal for unit No. 2. The document was prepared by Eng. Mansour Mohamed Sleiman, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras El-Din, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company.

Issue a work order approved by the station operations department; work is carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department, and those carrying out the maintenance must hold an occupational safety and health category card
Make sure the area is fenced off to define the work area and warning signs are placed
Notify the No. 2 thermal control room operator that a spurious 'Pump off' signal will appear and the No. 2 electric feed pump switch will light, together with an alarm

sections_en.text: New contactor, identical to the faulty one in contact points and switching time
Needle-nose pliers, flat pliers, ordinary pliers 6 inch
Ordinary screwdriver 3 x 100 mm, ordinary screwdriver 6 x 150 mm
Wire stripper, test lead 2 x 20 mm

items: New contactor, identical to the faulty one in contact points and switching time
Needle-nose pliers, flat pliers, ordinary pliers 6 inch
Ordinary screwdriver 3 x 100 mm, ordinary screwdriver 6 x 150 mm
Wire stripper, test lead 2 x 20 mm

rows: Check the control circuit of the electric feed pump 2 No. (MK169-1201)

Test the contactor (d2) by isolating one 110 Vdc terminal and test points (1,2), (3,4), (5,6), (7,8), identify which points have a bad contact, and check the operation of the timer for connecting points (7,8).
Place the pump switch in the off position and make sure the contactor d2 is in the connected state and that the switch lamp is lit
If the switch lamp is not lit, make sure 110 Vdc reaches the lamp
Short-circuit points (7,8) and observe the appearance of the Pump Off signal
If the signal does not appear, make sure 110 Vdc reaches points (7,8)
If the 110 Vdc is isolated, test the auxiliary contact points

If there is a bad contact on any of the auxiliary contact points, replace the auxiliary contactor with a new one exactly identical to the faulty one, of type (HWRa-T/1s+10+1WiR/110V), test it and make sure the signal appears
Make sure conditions return to normal and close the work order

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the electric feed pump trip indication signal for unit No. 2 not appearing on the boiler panel and the pump switch indication lamp on the control desk; these procedures are carried out when a fault occurs in the electric feed pump trip indication signal for unit No. 2. The document was prepared by Eng. Mansour Mohamed Sleiman, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, endorsed by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras El-Din, General Manager of Assiut Thermal Station, approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and MPIS Coordinator for the company. | 
Safety precautions
Issue a work order approved by the station operations department; work is carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer approved by the head of the instrument maintenance department, and those carrying out the maintenance must hold an occupational safety and health category card | 
Make sure the area is fenced off to define the work area and warning signs are placed | 
Notify the No. 2 thermal control room operator that a spurious 'Pump off' signal will appear and the No. 2 electric feed pump switch will light, together with an alarm |

Place the pump switch in the off position and make sure the contactor d2 is in the connected state and that the switch lamp is lit | 3.
If the switch lamp is not lit, make sure 110 Vdc reaches the lamp | 4.
Short-circuit points (7,8) and observe the appearance of the Pump Off signal | 5.
If the signal does not appear, make sure 110 Vdc reaches points (7,8) | 6.
If the 110 Vdc is isolated, test the auxiliary contact points | 7.
If there is a bad contact on any of the auxiliary contact points, replace the auxiliary contactor with a new one exactly identical to the faulty one, of type (HWRa-T/1s+10+1WiR/110V), test it and make sure the signal appears | 8.
Make sure conditions return to normal and close the work order | 9.
